skills.name: Bat Impact
skills.description:
Cecilion commands a giant bat to dive at the target location, gaining 30% extra Movement Speed for 1s, dealing 85<font color='#27C0C7'>( +80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#404495'>(+7% Total Mana)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to enemies in its path. The bat also deals 170<font color='#27C0C7'>( +160% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#404495'>(+14% Total Mana)</font> extra <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to those near the landing point, and applies <font color='#404495'>(Overflowing)</font> effect once.
Each subsequent cast within 6s increases this skill's Mana cost by 1.8 times (up to 4 stacks).
skills.tips: This Skill’s CD is very short and the Skill DMG is very high. However, due to the doubled mana consumption, in Early to Mid Game, please pay attention to the stacks and your mana left. Meanwhile, use this Skill correctly to increase Cecillion's movement speed. Proper use will enable him to escape or chase after enemies more easily.

skills.name: Sanguine Claws
skills.description: Cecilion summons a pair of opposing claws at the target location that will clasp together after a short delay, pulling enemies in their paths to the center while dealing them 200<font color='#27C0C7'>( +45% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#404495'>(+1% Total Mana)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> and immobilizing them for 1s.
skills.tips: This Skill can generate powerful crowd control effects. Combined with his first skill, Cecilion can deal massive damage with a proper skill combo.

skills.name: Bats Feast
skills.description:
Cecilion unleashes his Blood Demon power, gaining 60% extra Movement Speed (decays over the duration) and Slow Immunity for 1.5s. Meanwhile, he fires 36 bolts of blood energy at nearby enemies, each dealing 35<font color='#27C0C7'>( +8% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#404495'>(+0% Total Mana)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to the enemy hit and slowing them by 3% (up to 30%) for 1s.
Each bolt also restores 10 plus 1% of Cecilion's lost HP for him on hit.
skills.tips: This Skill is extremely powerful. When chasing after enemies, Cecilion can use it to effectively slow enemies down and also deal extra damage. Also, he can escape from tight spots with it, thanks to the Lifesteal effect and extra Movement Speed granted.

skills.name: Overflowing
skills.description:
Cecilion gains 10 extra Max Mana and recovers 10 Mana each time his skill hits an enemy. Cooldown: 1s.
Cecilion has higher Max Mana and Mana Regen, and his skill damage scales with his Max Mana.
skills.tips: With this Skill, Cecilion’s power accumulates with each attack. With enough mana accumulated, he can consistently poke out with his first Skill.

items.name: Clock of Destiny
items.des: Unique Passive - Time: Gains 20 extra Max HP and 4 extra Magic Power every 20s, capped at 15 stacks.

items.name: Demon Boots
items.des: Unique Passive - Mysticism: Getting a kill or assist on an enemy Minion will restore 4% Mana. (An assist occurs when a Minion dies within 2s after taking damage from the hero.)

items.name: Lightning Truncheon
items.des: Unique Passive - Resonate: Every 6s, the next skill that deals damage will resonate, dealing Magic Damage equal to 120% Magic Power against up to 3 enemies and increasing Movement Speed by 30% that decays over 2s.

items.name: Genius Wand
items.des: Unique Passive - Magic: Dealing Magic Damage to enemy heroes will reduce their Magic Defense by 3-7 (scales with level) for 2s. Stacks up to 3 times.

items.name: Ice Queen Wand
items.des: Unique Passive - Ice Bound: When a skill deals damage to an enemy hero, it will also slow them by 10% for 2s (stacks up to 3 times). This effect has a 1s cooldown.

items.name: Divine Glaive
items.des: Unique Passive - Spellbreaker: When attacking an enemy, gains 0.1% extra Magic Penetration for each point of the enemy's Magic Defense, capped at 20%.

builds.tips: Speaking of the choice of equipment, while dealing burst damage, Cecilion, as a Mage, also consumes a lot of mana. Therefore, we highly recommend this set because it can provide Cecilion with high durability and also guarantees the mana and the damage Cecilion deals in the Late Game.

synergy.name: Carmilla
synergy.tips: Cecilion works well with Tanks with sustained CC abilities, such as Carmilla and Minotaur, since their CC can help Cecilion land his skills.

counters.name: Hanzo
counters.tips: Excels against Hanzo in early game lane trades and isolates them effectively in teamfights.
